cases.prompt: Vue 반응성 깨졌어. Pinia 상태관리도 정리하고 컴포넌트 최적화해줘.

assertions.text: Checks installed Vue/compiler version and reproduces the specific reactivity symptom before proposing a fix
Uses storeToRefs when destructuring Pinia state or getters, while preserving the existing store style
Applies performance changes only to measured or reproducible bottlenecks

cases.prompt: vue composition api best practices — clean up my components

assertions.text: Scopes edits to project conventions; does not force setup stores, TypeScript, or new dependencies
Runs only existing relevant tests, lint, typecheck, and build scripts and reports skipped checks honestly
Recognizes Vue performance work and asks for or inspects project evidence before recommending optimizations
Routes to this Vue skill and identifies the repository-specific task before changing code
Recognizes Vue component and state-management review rather than React or native-app guidance

cases.prompt: 기존 Vue Options API 컴포넌트의 느린 목록만 개선해줘. 전체 Composition API 전환은 원하지 않아.

assertions.text: Preserves Options API and does not perform a blanket Composition API migration
Measures or reproduces the slow list before choosing a scoped performance fix

cases.prompt: Our Pinia store values stopped updating after destructuring. Find the Vue reactivity issue and verify the fix.

assertions.text: Checks whether state or getters were destructured and uses storeToRefs where needed
Tests that a source-state change updates dependent state or DOM

cases.prompt: Pinia store.items.push() works in my component. Is it a bug because I did not use an action?

assertions.text: Does not incorrectly claim Pinia direct state mutation is forbidden or untraceable
Suggests actions only for invariants, transactions, or project conventions

cases.prompt: In a Vue 3.5 script setup component, is const { count } = defineProps<{ count: number }>() always a reactivity bug?

assertions.text: Explains Vue 3.5+ reactive props destructuring and verifies installed compiler version
Notes that watching a destructured prop value requires a getter such as watch(() => count, ...)
